issues.reason: "Conference Board economist Ken Goldstein" is a close appositive, and the appositive rule under *Tense / modality over a copular clause* states its typing atom takes the host clause's wrapper mechanically — the host "said" is past, so the bare (Member ken_goldstein economist) violates it (the same parser correctly wrapped the appositive in tierD-000072).

*Core patterns* / Sealing: a definite NP's Member / Name typing atom projects to top level in every sealing construct alike, so the definite "the end of the recession" cannot keep (Member sk_end_1 end) inside the Theme seal while its sibling sk_recession_1 typing sits outside.

(ParticleFromNormal 1.5 0.15) is a symmetric distribution centred on 1.5, which asserts the gap is as likely above 1.5 years as below — false of the one-sided "almost a year and a half", and outside the tight/loose hedge bands *Measures & units* defines.

gaps_confirmed: No licensed head relates a person to a named organization given as a bare pre-nominal affiliation ("Conference Board economist Ken Goldstein").
One-sided approximators ("almost", "nearly", "just over") have no encoding, and BeforeBy has no bounded (AtMost) variant to carry an upper-bounded gap.
A discourse/phasal adverb ("finally") has no carrier — the aspectual-particle set is closed at again/still/already/yet and Manner would mis-slot it.
Direct verbatim quotation as a speech verb's complement is not covered; *Propositional attitudes* licenses only a finite that-clause.
new_gaps: A definite NP's non-typing description atoms inside a seal (here (Of sk_end_1 sk_recession_1)) have no stated side: the projection rule names only Member / Name.
repair_summary: Wrapped the appositive typing as (Past (Member ken_goldstein economist)) per the host clause's tense; moved (Member sk_end_1 end) out of the Theme seal to top level as a definite referent's projecting typing atom; replaced the symmetric (BeforeBy … (ParticleFromNormal 1.5 0.15) year) with the plain licensed ordering (Before sk_end_1 sk_point_1), dropping the unrepresentable one-sided magnitude rather than inventing a bounded gap head.
notes: Everything else in the parse holds: the non-factive seal under say's Theme, the (To …) oblique of the prepositional verb "points to", the nominalization argument (Of …), and the projected definite Leading Economic Index / recession typings.
